name: Yajur
source:
A mysterious man who is revived from a corpse that [url=/c48267]Eve[/url] and the rest discover.
Because the resurrection was imperfect his memories are still hazy, but because he had an ID with him he knows his name and that he was previously a member of the parliament.
A bit of a playboy, he is always making passes at Eve.
